answer_text:
Let the indices be taken cyclically, so \(f_{101}=f_1\) and \(x_{101}=x_1\).

Since \(x_i\) is a root of \(f_i\),

\[
f_i(x_i)=a x_i^2+b x_i+c_i=0.
\]

Now consider each term in the sum:

\[
f_{i+1}(x_i)=a x_i^2+b x_i+c_{i+1}.
\]

Using \(a x_i^2+b x_i=-c_i\), we get

\[
f_{i+1}(x_i)=-c_i+c_{i+1}=c_{i+1}-c_i.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\begin{aligned}
&f_2(x_1)+f_3(x_2)+\cdots+f_{100}(x_{99})+f_1(x_{100})\\
&=(c_2-c_1)+(c_3-c_2)+\cdots+(c_{100}-c_{99})+(c_1-c_{100})\\
&=0.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus the required sum is

\[
\boxed{0}
\]
